candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order:8000/v1/orders returns HTTP 500. Traces and logs show the order service failing with 500 on every checkout correlation, and the gateway propagates that as 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, redis, payment) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order service 500s in traces and logs; gateway is a pass-through of the downstream failure. Order's internal cause is not yet observed, so the bounded candidate is the propagated HTTP 500.
